ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 7 — Annual Wellness Visit, Initial — Dwight D. Eisenhower — True-date frame: synthetic events are moved into the patient's historical lifetime. Codes, instruments, and treatments remain modern and are anachronistic.

text.paragraph: Initial annual wellness visit; no new complaints. [S]

Mr. Eisenhower comes for his first annual wellness visit, three weeks after his one-year coronary review, at which ticagrelor was stopped and he continued aspirin alone. He completed the health risk assessment before the visit. He has had no chest pain, breathlessness, palpitations, or further nosebleeds, and has not needed nitroglycerin. He works full time, travels often, walks most days, and plays golf twice a week. He takes his medicines from a weekly organizer and has added no over-the-counter medicines or supplements. He has had no falls. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 20 minutes, with his consent. He has named a health care agent and completed a written health care directive; a copy is now in the chart. He wants full treatment, including coronary procedures and intensive care, for any condition from which he could return to an active life. He would not want prolonged life support if he were unlikely to recover the ability to think and communicate. He will review these wishes with his agent. [S]
